annotation.title_en: HB 255 — Unmanned Aircraft Systems (Alaska 28th Legislature, 2013-2014), Chapter 105 SLA 14
named_instruments_referenced: Alaska Legislative Task Force on UAS Interim Report
annotation.summary_en: This is the Alaska Legislature's status page for HB 255, a law on unmanned aircraft systems (drones) and on images they capture. It lists bill versions, committee hearings, supporting documents and the legislative history. The bill passed the House 37–1 and the Senate 20–0, was signed into law on 28 July 2014 as Chapter 105 SLA 14, and took effect on 26 October 2014.
key_provisions_or_claims: Act relating to unmanned aircraft systems and to images captured by them
Signed into law 7/28/2014 as Chapter 105 SLA 14; effective 10/26/2014
Supporting materials include IACP UA guidelines and a Legislative Task Force UAS interim report
Fiscal notes from the Department of Law, Department of Public Safety and University of Alaska showed zero fiscal impact
